FAQ

Quick answers.

Do I need a key?

No. Pawa-Lite is keyless, so there are no key systems or checkpoints to get through.

Where do I download it?

Use the Download button on this site. It opens a short dialog that walks you through the steps and starts the file.

What is the difference between Executor and External?

The Executor attaches automatically and runs your scripts. The External runs outside the Roblox process and focuses on visuals such as ESP and aim assistance.

Where do I get help?

Join the Discord for updates, community scripts and support.
